notes: A round grinding stone on a stone seat, for a working corner of a garden or a cottage floor.

It is a solid mass in src/footprints.js, so it is walked around rather than through. It grinds nothing: the craft recipes in src/journey.js read only saved shelf resources, and this object holds none.
The voxel scene draws it through the generic prop branch of src/voxel-world.js furniture(); world.js draws the same silhouette on the pixel map.
